briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies global AGI race amid Chinese compute surge

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models this month as quarterly AI funding hits $11.9B. Geopolitical tensions rise with US export controls tightening and China accelerating domestic chip production.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced reasoning; Anthropic countered with Claude 4 Opus; DeepSeek-V3 matched performance at lower cost while Meta open-sourced Llama 4.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target multi-agent risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announced 50GW data center expansions; NVIDIA shipped Blackwell Ultra batches while TSMC ramps 2nm production for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
